description: This file defines a React functional component named Navbar which renders an admin panel's navigation bar with links and a logout button. It uses React Router for navigation and interacts with a dataService for logout functionality.

methods.name: Navbar({ user })
methods.description: React functional component rendering the navigation bar with conditional links based on user authentication status.

methods.name: onLogout
methods.description: Asynchronous function that logs out the user via dataService and navigates to the login page.
